article.headline: Will Pruitt scores 24 to lead Lipscomb over Bellarmine 87-53
article.description: — Will Pruitt scored 24 points as Lipscomb beat Bellarmine 87-53 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Will Pruitt scores 24 to lead Lipscomb over Bellarmine 87-53
article.story: LOUISVILLE, Ky. -- — Will Pruitt scored 24 points as Lipscomb beat Bellarmine 87-53 on Thursday night. Pruitt also contributed seven rebounds for the Bisons (12-6, 4-1 Atlantic Sun Conference). Jacob Ognacevic scored 17 points and added 16 rebounds. Grant Asman went 4 of 4 from the field (3 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 11 points. The Knights (3-15, 0-5) were led by Jack Karasinski, who posted 14 points. Myles Watkins added 12 points and Landin Hacker scored nine. The Knights have lost eight in a row. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
